headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 68%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 12% and comprehensive 7%; a new tab follows the same scenarios to the end of 2027. Since the midterms, Trump has squeezed Iran with a wider naval blockade and two minor strikes on Qeshm rather than resuming a campaign, while Tehran has hardened its seven conditions and lifted its missile-range cap, so a deal this year looks less likely. Through 2027 the odds lean toward a thin deal, because a Democratic Congress controls war funding from Jan. 3 and both parties will want the war settled before 2028.
